description: This file contains utility functions for generating documentation links, including creating markdown links for classes and members, rendering links based on language and output type, and processing content to include Playwright documentation URLs. It also exports functions for these utilities.

methods.name: createMarkdownLink
methods.description: Generates a markdown link to a class member documentation page, constructing the URL hash based on member type and name.

methods.name: createClassMarkdownLink
methods.description: Creates a markdown link to a class documentation page.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Returns a renderer function that generates documentation links based on language and output type, handling classes, methods, events, and properties.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Maps programming language identifiers to relative documentation path segments.

methods.name: formatClassName
methods.description: Formats class names for assertions based on the target programming language.

methods.name: assertionArgument
methods.description: Returns the argument name used in assertion functions based on the class name.

methods.name: renderJSSignature
methods.description: Creates a string representing the JavaScript function signature with optional parameters.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Replaces markdown links in content with URLs pointing to the Playwright documentation site.
